latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of sitemap-generator.

- Generate XML sitemaps by crawling websites or scanning local HTML/Markdown files.
- Supports robots.txt generation with sitemap reference.
- Offers multiple output formats: XML, text, and JSON.
- Auto-discovers pages via link extraction and filters non-HTML assets.
- No external dependencies; requires Python 3.6+.
